items.item: A breadcrumb shows the path back to the customer list and includes the customer's name
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb]: Sales / Customers (link) / Công ty TNHH Minh Phát (aria-current=page)

items.item: The record header shows name and ID, a status badge with text, at most four key fields and exactly one primary action
items.evidence: h1 'Công ty TNHH Minh Phát', 'CUS-0231', badge 'Active' (renderStatus), dl#keyFields has exactly 4 items (Account owner, Industry, Open balance, Last order), one filled-blue button 'Edit customer' (#editBtn); the ... button is outlined and secondary

items.item: Secondary actions are grouped in an overflow menu
items.evidence: #moreBtn opens headerMenu(): Log a call, Merge duplicates, Export customer data, Archive customer, Delete customer (danger, separated)

items.item: Content is organised in sections or tabs, not a long stack of unrelated cards
items.evidence: role=tablist with Overview / Contacts 5 / Orders 14 / Activity; overview uses titled sections (Customer information, Recent orders, Account summary, Addresses, Notes)

items.item: The activity history is a timeline with absolute timestamps (relative times only with the absolute value available)
items.evidence: fillActivity renders <ol><li> with <time datetime=...> showing dt(a.t) e.g. '03/11/2026 14:20', newest first, plus actor, kind label, and old to new change diffs. No relative times. It is a time-stamped feed rather than a drawn rail, but it is a chronological timeline

items.item: The recent orders table right-aligns amounts and formats currency
items.evidence: orderRow: td.text-right.tabular-nums with vnd.format(o.total) (vi-VN grouping, e.g. 21.400.000) under header 'Total (VND)' right-aligned; audit numericCells misaligned 0

items.item: Sections without data show an empty state with a next step
items.evidence: emptyBlock used for orders ('No orders yet' + Create order), contacts ('No contacts yet' + Add contact), activity ('No activity yet' + Add note); demoState 'No related records' toggles them. Filter-empty states offer Clear filters. Addresses/Notes cards have no empty state but are static

items.item: Avatars appear only for people; the company is shown with its logo or no image
items.evidence: Company header has no image or avatar. Initials circles appear only for contact people in fillContacts and for the signed-in user (NH) in the top bar

notes: Clean result; audit score 100 with no violations. Sidebar is light slate with a single blue accent (not navy plus indigo). No gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles, greeting, uppercase tracking, hover-lift or oversized radius (max rounded-lg on dialogs, rounded-md elsewhere). Minor non-tells: tinted pill badges for status, and a 'Mock data state' select left in the page footer as demo scaffolding. Customer-wide Notes/Addresses are plain bordered boxes, not card-in-card. Only the first 574 of 759 source lines were read in full plus lines 660-759; the unread middle is form dialogs, which do not affect the checklist.
